title: Entrails
summary: EN'TRAILS, n. 1. The internal parts of animal bodies; particularly, the guts or intestines; the bowels; used chiefly in the plural.2. The internal parts; as the entrails of the earth.The dark entrails

inlines.v: EN'TRAILS, n. 1. The internal parts of animal bodies; particularly, the guts or intestines; the bowels; used chiefly in the plural.2. The internal parts; as the entrails of the earth.The dark entrails of America.
